lines.say: Do you need to train every set to failure?
Failure means you can't do one more rep.
Big reviews compared training to failure with stopping a few reps short.
Muscle growth was about the same, as long as sets got close to failure.
But failure makes you more tired, so you recover slower.
So on most sets, stop one to three reps before failure.
Ask yourself: how many more could I do? If the answer is more than three, it was too easy.
Next: how important is sleep for growth?
